title: The stall watch resolves a relative log path against the command's folder, and does not kill a live run whose output a pipe holds back
why: Two gaps (lane draft-pr-guard-text-false-alarm via the coordinator, 05:02 CST Nov 8): (1) hooks/stall_watch.py resolves a relative --also log path against the session cwd, not the command's; (2) a run piped to `| tail -1` holds back its output, so the 300 s quiet timer kills live work.
note: Fix: (1) resolve a relative --also path against the command's cwd, or refuse with a remedy that names the absolute form; (2) first check whether #1823 (step stall-watch-quiet-lint) covers a suite run; if not, count the child process's life, not only its output. Red tests first. Queued after draft-pr-unquoted-body-sq-subst in the same lane (item 386 b). Queue fix (owner 13:20 CST Nov 7). Slug from the coordinator. Filed 05:08 CST Nov 8.
